MISSIONS_DESC: Complete daily tasks to build discipline and maintain your streak.
MISSION_5AM_DESC: Rise before 5:00 AM and dominate the day.
MISSION_GYM_DESC: Complete a heavy workout session in the gym.
MISSION_READ_DESC: Read at least 10 pages of a book.
MISSION_DEEP_WORK_DESC: Work on your projects for 4 hours without distraction.
IS_18_PLUS_PROFILE_DESC: Require visitors to verify they are 18+ before viewing your profile.
MISSION_COLD_SHOWER_DESC: Take a cold shower first thing in the morning to build mental toughness.
MISSION_HEALTHY_MEAL_DESC: Eat a clean, high-protein meal. No junk food, no sugars, pure fuel.
MISSION_NO_SCROLLING_DESC: Avoid mindless scrolling on social media for at least 6 hours.
MISSION_NETWORKING_DESC: Reach out to one high-value person or business contact.
MISSION_PLANNING_DESC: Write down your goals for tomorrow. Master your time, execute precisely.
MISSION_CARDIO_DESC: Complete a 5km run or 30 minutes of intense cardio activity.
CAT_CORE_DESC: The fundamental missions you need to start your day strong!
CAT_ADVENTURE_DESC: Start exploring the world and experiencing amazing things!
CAT_FITNESS_DESC: Take care of your body with intentional physical exercise!
CAT_HEALTH_DESC: Take care of your health with good habits!
CAT_COOKING_DESC: Learn to cook — it's an art worth mastering!
CAT_LEARNING_DESC: Learning never stops! Learn something new every day!
CAT_MINDFULNESS_DESC: Take care of your mental health with meditation and mindfulness!

MISSION_ADVENTURE_HIKE_DESC: Go for a walk or hike in the park or mountains for at least 1 hour. Get energy from nature.
MISSION_ADVENTURE_OUTDOOR_DESC: Go outside to see the sun or the stars. Align with natural light.
MISSION_ADVENTURE_NEW_PLACE_DESC: Go to a place you've never been to before, even if it's just a neighborhood.
MISSION_FITNESS_STRETCH_DESC: Do 15 minutes of active stretching or yoga to relax your muscles and improve flexibility.
MISSION_FITNESS_STRENGTH_DESC: Do a bodyweight or weight training workout for 30 minutes. Good technique = better results.
MISSION_FITNESS_WALK_DESC: Walk at least 5,000 steps or 3 kilometers. Stepping exercises are important for your health.
MISSION_HEALTH_WATER_DESC: Drink at least 2 liters of water today. Water helps with physical and mental performance.
MISSION_HEALTH_SLEEP_DESC: Schedule your sleep for 7-9 hours. Good sleep is the foundation of a healthy life.
MISSION_HEALTH_VEGGIES_DESC: Eat at least 3 servings of vegetables or fruit today. Plant food = energy and health.
MISSION_COOKING_MEAL_DESC: Cook a meal from scratch, even if it's simple. Cooking is an art and a science.
MISSION_COOKING_NEW_RECIPE_DESC: Try a new recipe or type of food you've never tried before.
MISSION_COOKING_PREP_DESC: Prepare some meals for the upcoming week. Organization = less stress.
MISSION_LEARN_SKILL_DESC: Learn something new about your interest, even if it's only 10 minutes. Learning never stops.
MISSION_LEARN_LANGUAGE_DESC: Try to learn 5 new words in a foreign language. Language opens doors.
MISSION_LEARN_COURSE_DESC: Watch a course or lecture on a topic you want to explore more.
MISSION_MEDITATION_DESC: Do 10 minutes of meditation or mindfulness. Mental calm = clearer thinking.
MISSION_JOURNALING_DESC: Write down your thoughts or three things you're grateful for today.
MISSION_GRATITUDE_DESC: Thank someone or think of three things you're grateful for.
MISSION_CREATIVE_ART_DESC: Draw, paint, or make something creative, even if it's simple.
MISSION_CREATIVE_MUSIC_DESC: Listen to a new song or music genre, or play a musical instrument.
MISSION_CREATIVE_WRITE_DESC: Write a story, poem, or text about anything you want.
MISSION_SOCIAL_CALL_DESC: Call or send a message to a friend or family member you haven't spoken to in a while.
MISSION_SOCIAL_HELP_DESC: Help someone with a small thing today. Kindness makes the world better.
MISSION_SOCIAL_MEET_DESC: Meet up with someone in person for coffee or a walk if you can.
FOUNDER_AFFILIATION_DESC: Vincula tu perfil a una página de fundador (muestra la insignia de fundador junto al nombre de usuario).
MATRIX_OVERLAY_DESC: Activa una lluvia digital brillante de Matrix en el fondo

NEURAL_NARRATOR_DESC: Activa el botón del lector de texto a voz junto al de traducción
MISSION_GYM_CORE_DESC: Haz 100 abdominales o 5 minutos de plancha.
MISSION_ADV_NATURE_DESC: Pasa 1 hora caminando en un bosque o sendero de montaña.
MISSION_ADV_SEA_DESC: Nada en aguas abiertas o date un chapuzón en el mar helado.
MISSION_ADV_URBAN_DESC: Camina 10km por la ciudad descubriendo 3 lugares nuevos.
MISSION_SURV_SHELTER_DESC: Construye un refugio básico de supervivencia con materiales naturales.
MISSION_SURV_FAST_DESC: No consumas calorías durante 24 horas. Solo agua.
MISSION_SURV_FIRE_DESC: Haz fuego al aire libre sin cerillas ni encendedor.
MISSION_MIND_MEDITATE_DESC: Medita en completo silencio durante 30 minutos.
MISSION_MIND_FOCUS_DESC: Trabaja en tu tarea más importante por 4 horas sin distracciones.
MISSION_MIND_READ_DESC: Lee 50 páginas de un libro educativo o de no ficción.
MISSION_COMBAT_REFLEX_DESC: Realiza 15 minutos de ejercicios intensos de reflejos o evasión.

MISSION_COMBAT_SHADOW_DESC: Haz boxeo de sombra a alta intensidad por 6 asaltos (3 mins).
